# asc_load_balancer (Resource)

Manages a load balancer in the ASC platform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Create a load balancer
resource "asc_load_balancer" "example" {
  name      = "my-load-balancer"
  scheme    = "some-scheme"
  sku_id    = "lb-small"
  vpc_id    = asc_vpc.example.id
  subnet_id = asc_subnet.example.id
  algorithm = "round-robin"

  listeners = [
    {
      protocol = "TCP"
      port     = 80
    }
  ]

  backends = [
    {
      ip   = "10.0.0.10"
      port = 8080
    },
    {
      ip   = "10.0.0.11"
      port = 8080
    }
  ]

  health_check = {
    protocol            = "TCP"
    port                = 8080
    interval_seconds    = 10
    timeout_seconds     = 5
    healthy_threshold   = 2
    unhealthy_threshold = 2
  }

  tags = {
    environment = "production"
  }
}

output "load_balancer_id" {
  description = "The ID of the created load balancer"
  value       = asc_load_balancer.example.id
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `algorithm` (String) The load balancing algorithm
- `backends` (Attributes List) Backend targets that receive traffic from the load balancer. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--backends))
- `listeners` (Attributes List) listeners for the load balancer. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--listeners))
- `name` (String) The name of the load balancer. Must be unique within the namespace.
- `scheme` (String) The load balancer scheme
- `sku_id` (String) The SKU id for the load balancer.
- `subnet_id` (String) The id of the subnet the load balancer is deployed into.
- `vpc_id` (String) The id of the VPC the load balancer is deployed into.

### Optional

- `health_check` (Attributes) health-check configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--health_check))
- `tags` (Map of String) User defined tags attached to the load balancer.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the load balancer.

Required:

- `ip` (String) The backend target IP address.
- `port` (Number) The backend target port.

- `protocol` (String) The listener protocol


<a id="nestedatt--health_check"></a>
### Nested Schema for `health_check`

Required:

- `healthy_threshold` (Number) The number of consecutive successful health checks required to mark a backend healthy.
- `interval_seconds` (Number) The interval, in seconds, between health checks.
- `port` (Number) The health-check port.
- `protocol` (String) The health-check protocol.
- `timeout_seconds` (Number) The time, in seconds, to wait for a health-check response.
- `unhealthy_threshold` (Number) The number of consecutive failed health checks required to mark a backend unhealthy.
